title: ALT 04/2022: Field Near Druid Inn Cottage, Wrexham Road, Pontblyddyn, Mold
text:
Y TRIBIWNLYS TIR AMAETHYDDOL (CYMRU)

IN THE AGRICULTURAL LAND TRIBUNAL (WALES)

Reference:   ALT 04/2022

Applicant:  Rachael Anne Macleay (Represented by Parry Davies Clwyd-Jones
Lloyd LLP)

Respondents: Karen Bowden and Steven Keating (Not represented)

Type:
Land Drainage

Property
Field Near Druid Inn Cottage, Wrexham Road, Pontblyddyn, Mold,
CH7 4HG

Judge:
G Wilson (Deputy Chairman)

Withdrawal (Rule 6)

UPON the Applicant having applied to withdraw her application dated 7 March 2022
(submitted undercover of a letter dated 21 March 2022) by virtue of paragraph 6 of
schedule 1 to the Agricultural Land Tribunals (Rules) Order 2007/3105.

AND UPON the Respondent having withdrawn their applications to oppose the
withdrawal and seek additional remedies (correspondence from the Respondent dated
9 August 2023).

IT IS ORDERED THAT: -

The Applicant’s application made pursuant to the Land Drainage Act 1991 shall be
treated as withdrawn.

G Wilson Deputy Chairman of the Agricultural Lands Tribunal Wales

Dated 24 August 2023
